simulation_boundary: All v2 queries are deterministic simulated vignettes and boundary cases, not real users and not evidence of user value.
holdout_visibility: Queries are checked in and visible; only labels are sealed. This prevents label tuning but is not a private, externally custodied or real-user holdout.

rules: Union and deduplicate every required system Top-50 before labels are exposed.
Freeze and fingerprint all nine complete 200-query runs and their canonical union before any raw review label is revealed.
Persist system, rank, code, model, KB, embedding and query-set fingerprints outside the blinded review bundle.
Every system code, model and KB SHA-256 must resolve to an authority artifact; an optional lowercase 40-hex source commit is recorded separately and never substitutes for content hashing.
Randomize candidate order and hide system identity, rank and prior model judgments from reviewers.
At least three independent reviewers label every pooled candidate; adjudicate all material disagreements.
Never treat an unjudged candidate as relevance zero and never compare a system outside the common judged pool.

preregistered_primary: holdout English graded nDCG@5 delta versus production endpoint

chinese_control.query_universe: all 40 in-scope Chinese DEV queries; rankings are recomputed from frozen production/challenger outputs

statistics.multiple_comparisons: The production endpoint versus one preregistered challenger is the sole confirmatory comparison; other system arms are candidate-pool controls and exploratory only.

decision_rule: Any missing label, missing system, incomplete common pool, fingerprint drift, unresolved adjudication, failed primary gate or safety regression is NO-GO. Holdout may be evaluated once; tuning after exposure requires a new holdout version.
